name: cropx/icon-columns
title: Icon Columns (Column-Major)
description: Header above 3–6 independent flex columns. Items are distributed column-by-column (top-to-bottom within each column, then left-to-right), so column heights are completely independent — a tall item in one column never shifts items in another. Each item has an icon, heading, body, and optional CTA link.

heading.default: One platform for every layer of your operation

default.heading: Manage all your farms, fields, and crops in one place
default.body: The CropX platform aggregates data from across your entire operation in a single, customisable interface — with farm management tools to organise and schedule activities.

default.heading: Make timely, data-driven agronomic decisions
default.body: Insights and decision-support systems — covering disease risk, irrigation scheduling, and crop management — help your team act with confidence in real time.

default.heading: Connect all your IoT devices, sensors, and farm machines
default.body: The CropX system integrates with the equipment you already have — sensors, weather stations, irrigation controllers, and more — into one unified data layer.
